Triage first-touch: promoted to queue, type Task. Latent false positive, both assertions land on `Lint & Repo Gates`, and the trigger is exactly the kind of comment the neighbouring `ci.yml` block already writes for the sibling flag. Scope: make the recognizer in `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` ignore mentions inside trailing comments and `run:` block-scalar shell comments, and pin the trailing-comment case in that script's self-test the way `check-shard-attestation.mjs` pins its own. Whether to reuse `shellCommands()`/a shared helper or narrow locally is the implementer's call — measured against not growing a second bespoke lexer. Size/model suggestion: S, sonnet.

Scope from triage: make the recognizer ignore mentions inside **trailing comments** and **`run:` block-scalar shell comments**, and **pin the trailing-comment case in that script's self-test** the way `check-shard-attestation.mjs` pins its own. Whether to reuse `shellCommands()` / a shared helper or narrow locally is your call — measure it.

⭐ The sibling precedent is the whole point, and it is close at hand: `check-shard-attestation.mjs` already solved this with a real lexer that drops shell comments, and **its `--self-test` pins the comment case explicitly** (a `--verify`-in-a-comment fixture). PR #10817 landed today relying on exactly that property. `uncommentedYaml`'s `/^\s*#/` filter is the weaker half of the same idea.

⚠️ Latent false positive, but both assertions land on `Lint & Repo Gates`, and the trigger is *the ordinary way anyone would write a warning about this very flag* — the neighbouring `ci.yml` block already writes such a comment for the sibling flag. So this fires the first time someone documents the trap.

## Standing constraints

- ⛔ Governed, human-merge-only: `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` — propose wording in the report.
- ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/**`. ⛔ Never `git stash` — `refs/stash` is shared by every worktree of the repo.
- ⚠️ **A pipe swallows the exit code.** Capture as `cmd > log 2>&1; ec=$?`.
- ⚠️ ⭐ **#10853, measured today: `pnpm --filter <name>` with a name that does not exist prints `No projects matched the filters` and EXITS 0** — a whole verification round can read as green while nothing ran. Verify your filter matched; a negative control (`--filter @objectstack/definitely-not-a-package`) is the cheap way.
- ⚠️ **The shared checkout at `/home/user/objectstack` is STALE.** Measure against `origin/main` or your own worktree — never the shared tree. That mistake bit this seat twice today.
- ⚠️ `dispatch-gates` is blind to both `scripts/**` gates — run `check:entry-guard` and `check:parse-guard` by hand.
- ⚠️ Apply labels **additively** (`POST /issues/N/labels`), never a whole-set PUT, and read back after the size labeler runs.
- ⚠️ `main` has `Console Pin Gate` red for a known unrelated cross-repo reason (#10856) — **non-blocking**, ⛔ not yours, ⛔ not a signal about your change.

Report back to me; I review against GitHub and land it.
